definitions.explanation: The cost of subscribing to a newspaper, magazine, digital service, or other periodical publication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{購読|こうどく}{料|りょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is the newspaper subscription fee?

examples.japanese: {購読|こうどく}{料|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{解約|かいやく}→解約：06129_kaiyaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I canceled because the subscription fee went up.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧{購読|こうどく}{料|りょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}えば→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: If you pay the monthly subscription fee, you can read all the articles on this news site.

notes:
USAGE:
Traditionally used for newspapers and magazines, now also applied to digital subscriptions for news sites and online content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {購読|こうどく}{料|りょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay a subscription fee)
- ⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧{購読|こうどく}{料|りょう} (monthly subscription fee)
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{購読|こうどく}{料|りょう} (annual subscription fee)
- {購読|こうどく}{料|りょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧ (subscription price increase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{購読|こうどく}→購読：04468_koudoku⟧: subscription — the act of subscribing, without specifying the fee
- {受信料|じゅしんりょう}: reception fee — specifically NHK's broadcasting fee
